threads.body: This README states that the package “allows tracing executions” and “produces spans following the GenAI semantic conventions”, but the current instrumentor does not patch DSPy yet (it only constructs a TelemetryHandler). Please reword this to match the current state (setup/boilerplate only) or add the missing instrumentation so the README claims are accurate.
threads.hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+OpenTelemetry DSPy Instrumentation
+==================================
+
+|pypi|
+
+.. |pypi| image:: https://badge.fury.io/py/opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-dspy.svg
+   :target: https://pypi.org/project/opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-dspy/
+
+This library allows tracing executions made through the
+`DSPy framework <https://pypi.org/project/dspy/>`_.
+
+It produces spans following the `GenAI semantic conventions
+<https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/>`_.
+
+Installation
+------------
+
+::
+
+    pip install opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-dspy
+
+Usage
+-----
+
+.. code:: python
+
+    from opentelemetry.instrumentation.genai.dspy import (
+        DSPyInstrumentor,
+    )
+    import dspy
+
+    DSPyInstrumentor().instrument()
+

threads.body: The new DSPy package is wired into tox for oldest/latest unit tests, but it is missing the corresponding *-conformance environment/commands wiring that this repo requires for new instrumentation packages (py314 …-conformance envlist entry plus matching deps/commands). Add the dspy-conformance factor (and a tests/test_conformance.py + scenarios) so the test matrix shape stays consistent.

The classifiers omit Python 3.14 even though this repo’s test matrix targets 3.14 (see tox envlist patterns). Consider adding the “Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14” classifier for consistency with other packages.
